description: Fork of exp001_minimal_gpt with RoPE instead of learned absolute pos_emb. Single trade: nn.Embedding(seq_len, n_embd) + additive position term -> RotaryEmbedding(head_dim) applied to q,k inside MinimalAttention (standard half-rotation form, base=10000). All other hyperparameters identical to exp001 (depth=6, n_embd=384, n_head=6, lr=3e-4, wd=0.1, device_bs=8, total_bs=4096, 8000 steps, weight-tied head, zero-init residual projections). Reference: exp001 = 1.6256 bpb @ 23M params.
